params.prompt: Keep the composition, the layout and the painting technique of the last reference image (the approved draft) and repaint it as the finished gouache plate at higher resolution, with the same loose brushwork, the same paper grain and the same level of detail: do not add fine detail, do not sharpen, do not make it look like digital art. A storybook painting. Paint the Earth softer and less saturated, with gouache, not as a photograph. A dreamlike wide vista of the surface of the Moon: a gently rolling gray plain with soft round craters and scattered rocks, long soft shadows painted in deep blue and violet, never black. High in a deep indigo night sky with a few sparse stars hangs a large half-lit blue and white Earth. On the plain, a trail of small bootprints and tiny paw prints, a small cardboard box resting on the ground like a tiny capsule, and far away the small simple silhouette of a generic four-legged lunar landing stage with no markings. The student, in a small soft original spacesuit with a clear bubble helmet, and the cat, with a tiny bubble helmet, hop across the plain in low gravity. Foreground framed by the dark silhouette of a big boulder and the rim of a crater. Tiny in the frame, less than one tenth of the image height: the young engineering student from the first reference image (voluminous dark curly hair, warm brown skin, khaki jacket and cargo pants, brown crossbody bag) and her small gray-taupe cat from the second reference image (cream face and paws, blue collar with a small cyan round tag). Use the references only for their design and colors, and paint both with a few gouache brush strokes in the same style as the scene. Painted as a full-bleed plate from a hand-made illustrated storybook: traditional gouache and transparent watercolor on textured cold-press paper, visible brush strokes, soft wet-in-wet washes with the paper grain showing through, simplified flat shapes with loose painterly edges, very few small details, large calm areas. Restrained warm palette of cream, ochre, terracotta, muted tropical green and petrol-blue shadows; shadows are colored, never black; low saturation. Strong atmospheric perspective: the far distance is pale, hazy and bluish with almost no detail, and only the focal area is a little crisper. Composition in three layered planes like a paper theater: a dark, simple silhouette framing the foreground, the lit middle ground, and a pale background. Matte and handmade: no glossy highlights, no bloom, no lens flare, no light rays, no 3D render look, no digital sharpness, no hyper-detail. No text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no insignia, no emblems, no flags. No text, no logos, no interface.
